# MicroWeb

> MicroWeb is a high-performance custom software engineering, mobile app development, WhatsApp AI integration, and web design agency based in Kuching, Sarawak, and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Built on modern web and enterprise software stacks, this codebase is fully optimized for sub-second rendering, offline-first data resilience, search engine optimization (SEO), JSON-LD schema injection, agentic AI workflows, and enterprise cross-platform integrations.

---

## Core Architecture & Agency Capabilities

### 1. Agency Technical Stack & Engineering Capabilities (Client Deliverables)
- **Enterprise Backends**: Enterprise microservices and backend pipelines built with **Java** and **Spring Boot** for high-availability transaction processing and database ledger sync.
- **Zero-Open-Ports Security & Cloud VPS**: Hardened containerized infrastructure running full-stack Docker apps (`cloudflared`, `nginx:alpine`, `postgres:18`) behind **Cloudflare Tunnel** with zero inbound open ports (blocking ports 80/443 at hypervisor and UFW firewalls) to eliminate automated reconnaissance, botnet scanning, and unauthenticated TLS handshake overhead.
- **Mobile Development Stack**: Cross-platform iOS and Android application development using **Flutter** and **React Native**, compiled natively using Apple **Xcode** (iOS) and Google **Android Studio** (Android).
- **Agentic AI & LLM Systems**: Autonomous AI pipelines and agentic workflows engineered with **Antigravity**, **Claude** (Anthropic), **Gemini** (Google DeepMind), **GPT models** (OpenAI), and self-hosted open-source models (Llama/Qwen).
- **Messaging API Integration**: Direct integration with **WhatsApp API** and **Meta API** for 24/7 automated customer communication and computer vision photo parsing.
- **Web Applications & Web Design**: Custom web applications built with **React JS** dynamic frontends, Astro static site generation, edge caching, and WebGL 3D client rendering.
- **Remote Edge Infrastructure & Multi-WAN Networking**: High-availability remote field networking, Multi-WAN gateway link aggregation (Starlink LEO + Multi-Carrier 4G LTE), token-bucket QoS bandwidth shaping, and isolated pure sine wave UPS power architecture.

### 2. Website Platform Stack (This Repository)
- **Astro v5 (`astro`) & React JS (`@astrojs/react`)**: Modern web framework supporting Static Site Generation (SSG), React JS component islands, MDX content collections, and zero-JS runtime defaults.
- **Tailwind CSS v3 (`@astrojs/tailwind`)**: Utility-first styling with HSL-tailored color tokens, dark/light theme switching, and responsive design systems.
- **Three.js & WebGL (`three`)**: Interactive client-side 3D graphics rendering engines for immersive product showcases and background matrices.
- **Astro Icon (`astro-icon`)**: Direct SVG icon utility, preconfigured for `carbon` and `tabler` icon libraries.
- **Formbricks (`@formbricks/js`)**: Interactive feedback collection, targeted user surveys, and analytics event pipelines.
- **Web3forms (`web3forms`)**: Zero-config contact and lead ingestion gateways.
- **Asset Pipelines (`astro-compress`, `astro:assets`)**: Automatic compile-time image conversion (WebP/AVIF) and minification of CSS, HTML, and JS bundles.

---

## Directory Layout & Key Modules

The codebase is organized as follows:
- **`src/assets/`**: Static styles, global resets, and visual assets (`styles/tailwind.css`).
- **`src/components/`**: Modular Astro UI blocks, navigation wrappers, dynamic widgets, and Schema.org metadata handlers:
  - `common/JsonLd.astro`: Centralized JSON-LD schema generator for `Organization`, `LocalBusiness`, `WebSite`, `Service` catalogs, and dynamic `BreadcrumbList`.
  - `common/Metadata.astro`: Canonical URL management, OpenGraph, Twitter card tags, and robots indexing controls.
  - `widgets/`: Configurable visual components (Heroes, Features grids, Telemetry stats, Conversion calculators, Latency simulators, Steps pipelines, Intake forms).
- **`src/content/`**: Strongly-typed content collections:
  - `config.ts`: Zod schema definitions for the `post` collection.
  - `post/`: MD/MDX case studies, portfolio articles, and technical whitepapers.
- **`src/layouts/`**: Master page wrappers (`Layout.astro`, `PageLayout.astro`, `LandingLayout.astro`, `MarkdownLayout.astro`).
- **`src/pages/`**: File-based router mapping endpoints to public URLs.
- **`src/utils/`**: Utility modules for permalink routing (`permalinks.ts`), post filtering (`blog.ts`), and image optimization pipelines (`images.ts`).

## Core Services & Technical Specifications

Below are the five primary service verticals offered by MicroWeb, detailed with technical architectures, performance metrics, framework tooling, and post/case study citations:

### 1. Web Design (Kuching & Sarawak)
- **Primary Routes**: [/web-design-kuching/](https://www.microweb.my/web-design-kuching/), [/web-design-sarawak/](https://www.microweb.my/web-design-sarawak/), [/web-development/](https://www.microweb.my/web-development/)
- **Target Intents**: High-conversion commercial websites for Sarawak SMEs, local search engine dominance, and cross-border regional expansion for West Malaysian/multinational brands.
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - **Sub-Second TTFB**: Edge-cached Astro static architecture with React JS islands delivering Time-To-First-Byte under 1.2s across Malaysia CDN nodes.
  - **Cross-Region Latency Mitigation**: Edge caching strategies tailored to eliminate South China Sea data routing latencies between Peninsular Malaysia origin servers and East Malaysian client viewports.
  - **Local Business Schema Injection**: Hardcoded JSON-LD `LocalBusiness` and `GeoCoordinates` schema properties pushing local sites to top Google Maps rankings.
  - **Mobile-First Engine**: Fluid, unbroken layouts designed for local mobile data connections (65%+ mobile user traffic).
  - **Transparent Pricing**: SME infrastructure packages starting from RM2,000 with zero hidden cloud maintenance fees.
- **Case Studies & Articles**:
  - [Malaysia Website Awards 2025 Case Study](https://www.microweb.my/clients/malaysia-website-awards-2025-microweb/): Official commercial category nomination and 74% evaluation scorecard breakdown (85% SEO, 80% Accessibility). Technical deep-dive on Astro.js SSG + Tailwind CSS + Cloudflare Pages edge distribution vs monolithic CMS, calculated Three.js 3D WebGL runtime performance trade-offs, and bespoke corporate identity implementation (e.g. Ford Sarawak).
  - [Kuching Website Design Service 2025](https://www.microweb.my/clients/kuching-website-design-service-2025/): Conversion-rate optimized regional SME acquisition engine.

### 2. Mobile App Development
- **Primary Routes**: [/mobile-app/](https://www.microweb.my/mobile-app/)
- **Target Intents**: Network-resilient, cross-platform iOS and Android mobile application engineering for enterprise field operations and logistics.
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - **Frameworks & IDEs**: Built with Flutter and React Native, using Xcode for iOS build targets and Android Studio for Android profiling and APK/AAB bundle generation.
  - **Offline-First Local Schemas**: Telemetry parameters write directly to local SQLite or encrypted device storage. Data auto-synchronizes with central servers upon network re-establishment (0ms offline render latency).
  - **Native Hardware API Integration**: Low-level BLE beacon scanning, camera optical character recognition (OCR), background GPS tracking tags, and native biometric keychain authentication (<180ms sync speed, 60fps+ target frame rate).
  - **Decoupled UI Threading**: Multi-threaded architecture isolating UI loops from heavy background queue syncs.
  - **Over-The-Air (OTA) Updates & Telemetry**: Instant app bundle hot-patches delivered to remote field staff alongside persistent remote crash telemetry.
- **Live Production App Builds & Proof**:
  - [Omnia Food Supply App on Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=my.com.omniafoodsupply.shop&pcampaignid=web_share): Production Android e-commerce & inventory distribution mobile app.
  - [MicroWeb iOS TestFlight Invite](https://testflight.apple.com/join/X4jQCMkT): Verified iOS build distribution channel on Apple TestFlight.
- **Case Studies & Articles**:
  - [Bluetooth Beacon Border Control](https://www.microweb.my/clients/bluetooth-beacon-border-control/): Continuous hardware-to-cloud BLE beacon tracking and border control telemetry network.
  - [Daigou Express Logistics App](https://www.microweb.my/clients/daigou-express-logistics/): Mobile field tracking app for cross-border supply chain operations.
  - [Finger Football Native Prototype](https://www.microweb.my/clients/finger-football-prototype/): 60fps native mobile execution and touch physics engine.
  - [Starbucks POS Installation](https://www.microweb.my/clients/starbucks-pos-installation/): Hardware mobile POS integration and field installation lifecycle.

### 3. Custom Software & Enterprise Systems
- **Primary Routes**: [/software/](https://www.microweb.my/software/), [/enterprise/](https://www.microweb.my/enterprise/), [/integration/](https://www.microweb.my/integration/)
- **Target Intents**: Decoupled, high-availability custom software backends, API connectivity wrappers, Java / Spring Boot enterprise services, and legacy ERP migrations.
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - **Backend Stack**: Enterprise-grade Java and Spring Boot microservices powering high-throughput transaction processing, paired with React JS dynamic frontends.
  - **High-Availability SLA**: 99.99% production uptime target with <12s horizontal container autoscaling.
  - **API Integration Layers**: Hardened REST and GraphQL abstraction bridges mapping modern edge frontends directly to legacy ERP ledgers, warehouse databases, and custom accounting software.
  - **Serverless & Bare-Metal Hybrid**: Serverless Firebase Cloud Functions for zero-maintenance auto-scaling alongside sovereign bare-metal Linux VPS instances for strict data isolation.
  - **Relational Data Clusters**: Encrypted PostgreSQL and embedded SQLite databases engineered for transactional privacy.
  - **Cross-Border Systems & Starlink Reverse DNS Integration**: Custom software integrations connecting local Malaysian business applications natively with enterprise WMS backends in China over Starlink satellite connections via dynamic reverse DNS routing (`http://winwinwms.cn:38329` & `https://www.winwinlssb.com/`), bypassing dynamic WAN IP shifts cost-efficiently without static IP overhead.
- **Live Production Platforms & Case Proof**:
  - [Bosoffice Corporate B2B Platform](https://www.bosoffice.com.my/): Live high-volume corporate B2B procurement and e-commerce software system.
  - [Win Win Logistics Platform](https://www.winwinlssb.com/): Regional supply chain management portal.
  - [Win Win WMS Reverse DNS Gateway](http://winwinwms.cn:38329): Cross-border WMS warehouse management system integration connecting local Malaysian applications natively with Chinese enterprise logistics nodes.
- **Case Studies & Articles**:
  - [Zero Open Ports: Full-Stack Docker Behind Cloudflare Tunnel](https://www.microweb.my/clients/zero-open-ports-docker-cloudflare-tunnel-vps/): Production blueprint on zero open ports VPS security for a regional cold-chain and warehouse management system across the MY/SG corridor. Disabling public inbound ports (80/443) at hypervisor and UFW firewalls using outbound encrypted Cloudflare Tunnels (`cloudflared`, `nginx:alpine`, and `postgres:18`) on a 4 GB VPS to eliminate agentic automated reconnaissance, Shodan bots, and TLS overhead.
  - [Surviving Mulu: Code, Cargo, and Jungle Wi-Fi](https://www.microweb.my/clients/surviving-mulu-code-cargo-and-jungle-wifi/): Firsthand field log running mission-critical internet infrastructure and network failover in the Borneo rainforest (Mulu, Sarawak) for an international executive leadership delegation. Deploying multi-carrier 4G modems, Omada multi-WAN load balancers, fast-roaming outdoor APs (802.11k/v), RF Tx power range tuning, emergency Starlink satellite failover after lightning strikes, and airport freight handling.
  - [Architectural Isomorphism: Remote Rainforest Edge Networks](https://www.microweb.my/clients/architectural-isomorphism-remote-rainforest-edge-networks/): High-availability Multi-WAN edge infrastructure deployment deep in the Borneo rainforest (Mulu, Sarawak) for a global executive leadership delegation. Multi-WAN link aggregation (Starlink LEO + 3x 4G LTE modems on TP-Link Omada ER707-M2), token-bucket QoS bandwidth shaping (4M/1M, 2M surge clamp), Layer 2 client isolation, and double-conversion online pure sine wave UPS stages eliminating satellite re-acquisition blackout loops.
  - [Cross-Border Architecture (Guangdong ⇄ Sarawak)](https://www.microweb.my/clients/cross-border-architecture-guangdong-sarawak/): Pragmatic single-box Docker stack on Hong Kong Lighthouse VPS with direct BGP peering (12ms to Shenzhen, 41ms to Sarawak), Tencent Cloud EdgeOne Anycast CDN, dual-region +86 SMS/Google OAuth identity mapping, and asynchronous AutoCount Open API sync via BullMQ.
  - [Cloudflare Workers & Edge AI Architecture](https://www.microweb.my/clients/cloudflare-workers-edge-ai-sarawak/): Production edge architecture eliminating container cold starts (V8 isolates), sub-2ms HMAC-SHA256 WhatsApp webhook verification via Web Crypto API, sub-50ms regional API latency, and 90%+ cloud cost reduction over AWS ECS/EKS.
  - [Win Win Cross-Border WMS Integration](https://www.microweb.my/clients/winwin-cross-border-wms-integration/): Architectural breakdown of connecting Malaysian local applications ([winwinlssb.com](https://www.winwinlssb.com/)) with Chinese enterprise WMS backends over Starlink satellite links via dynamic reverse DNS routing (`http://winwinwms.cn:38329`).

  - **Self-Hosted Private LLMs/LRMs**: Deploys open-source Large Language Models (Llama/Qwen) and Reasoning Models (LRMs) on private compute nodes, achieving 100% token cost savings and zero per-token SaaS fees.
  - **24/7 Conversational Automation**: Qualifies inbound leads, answers stock availability queries, syncs calendar appointments, and routes positive sentiment triggers straight to Google Business Profiles.

### 5. Web App & Web Development
- **Primary Routes**: [/web-development/](https://www.microweb.my/web-development/)
- **Target Intents**: Sub-second corporate web portals, modern web applications, static site generation, React JS component integration, and WebGL 3D client rendering engines.
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - **Core Web Vitals Metrics**: Guaranteed Google LCP < 1.2s, CLS 0.00, and mobile page speed score of 99+.
  - **Component-Driven Astro & React JS Architecture**: Atomic Tailwind utility styles paired with decoupled Astro and React JS component islands, removing dead CSS to minimize JavaScript execution drag.
  - **Build-Time Media Optimization**: Next-generation image format processing (WebP/AVIF) at compile time.
  - **Semantic Metadata & Canonical Routing**: Injects JSON-LD schema graphs and canonical URLs directly into page headers, preventing duplicate-indexing issues inside Google Search Console.
  - **WebGL 3D Rendering**: Real-time client-side 3D product visualizers built on Three.js.

## Development & Build Commands

| Command | Objective |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Starts local Astro development server at `http://localhost:4321/` |
| `npm run build` | Compiles static production build into `/dist/` with auto-minification |
| `npm run preview` | Previews built production static bundle from `/dist/` |
| `npm run check` | Runs TypeScript diagnostic check, ESLint rules, and Prettier formatting |
| `npm run fix` | Automatically formats codebase with Prettier and resolves autofixable lint errors |
